blocks.content: Course: HTML Fundamentals for Your First Webpage
Research shows that you learn more by doing things and gaining small victories with each step.
Therefore, you'll be learning HTML by building a blog page step by step.
With each blog component you build, you get a confidence boost that further fuels your drive to learn!
